# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 72 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 72 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_072_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 3 — More Rod Categories

**72:1** "Those who gave up their rods more dry than green — these are those who believed but lived a double life: they did some good but also did much that was evil. Some of them repented and were placed in the first tower; some repented and were placed in the second tower; others did not repent. These remain even now among the repentants."

**72:2** "Those who gave up their rods more green than dry — these are those who for the most part lived a good life, but did some evil, and who were not among the faithful for long. They repented quickly when they heard my commandments. Their dwelling is in the first tower."

**72:3** "Those who gave up their rods green with dried tips — these are those who were at all times good and faithful, but who had some small measure of envy and strife toward one another on account of matters of dignity and some rank. But when they heard my words, the greater part of them repented quickly, and their dwelling is in the first tower. Some of them were double-minded and their dwelling is in the second tower."

**72:4** "Those who gave up their rods half-green and half-dry — these are those who had become immersed in business dealings and had not clung to the holy ones. For this reason half of them is living and half dead. But many of them, when they heard my commandments, repented; and those who repented dwell in the first tower. Some of them were altogether double-minded and fell away. These have lost life."

**72:5** "Those who gave up their green rods but with shoots and fruit — these are those who suffered hardship for the name and endured it with a whole heart, and who laid down their lives."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of P.Mich. 130 with maximal literalness, preserving the systematic rod-interpretation of Similitude 8's second phase.*
